question: Do patients with cholera on a hospital bill have more lab tests than other patients? For each group give the number of patients, how many of them have at least one lab test, and the average number of lab tests per patient, counting patients without any as zero.
title: Lab tests: cholera patients vs other patients
note: Verified on the dev database (2,000 patients) on 2026-10-17: 2 rows. with cholera: 767 patients, 475 with a lab test (61.9%), 8.6 lab tests per patient; other patients: 1,233 patients, 597 (48.4%), 6.8.

question: When a patient has an allergy on record, how often do they also have an adverse event recorded? Give the number of patients with an allergy, how many of them have an adverse event, and the share.
title: Adverse events among patients with an allergy
note: Verified on the dev database (2,000 patients) on 2026-10-17: 1 row. 614 patients with an allergy, 110 of them with an adverse event, 17.9%.

question: By age decade and sex, how many patients had a drug prescribed or administered?
title: Drug prescriptions or administrations by age decade and sex
